translations.text: Blessed is the man who has not walked in the way of the wicked, has not stood in the counsel of sinners, and has not sat in the seat of mockers.
Instead, his delight is in the law of the Lord, and he meditates on his law day and night.
He will be like a tree planted beside a stream of water, which gives its fruit in its season and whose leaves do not fall. Everything he does succeeds.
The wicked are not like this, but are like chaff that the wind scatters.
Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
For the Lord knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
Why have the nations risen in tumult, and the peoples plotted in vain?
The kings of the earth and the rulers have risen and taken counsel together against the Lord and against his Anointed One.
Let us cut their bonds and remove their yoke from us.
The one who sits in heaven will laugh, and the Lord will mock them.
Then he will speak to them in his anger and terrify them in his fury.
I have established my king on Zion, my holy mountain.
To declare my covenant: the Lord said to me, “You are my son, and today I have fathered you.”
Ask of me, and I will give you the nations as your inheritance, and the ends of the earth as your possession.
You will shepherd them with an iron rod and shatter them like clay vessels.
Now, kings, be wise; accept correction, judges of the earth.
Serve the Lord with fear, and hold fast to him with trembling.
Accept discipline, lest the Lord become angry and you perish from his way, for his anger will soon blaze up. Blessed are all who trust in him.
Lord, how numerous my oppressors have become! Many have risen against me.
Many say to my soul, “There is no salvation for you in your God.”
You, Lord, are my helper, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
I called aloud to the Lord, and he answered me from his holy mountain.
I lay down and slept, and I awoke, because the Lord sustained me.
I will not fear the tens of thousands of people who have surrounded me and arrayed themselves against me.
Arise, Lord my God, and save me, for you have struck all my enemies on their jaws and broken the teeth of the wicked.
Salvation belongs to the Lord, and your blessing is upon your people forever.
When I called to you, you answered me, my God and the savior who vindicates me. In my distress you gave me relief. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
Human beings, how long will you conceal my honor, love emptiness, and seek falsehood forever?
Know that the Lord has wondrously set apart a chosen one for himself. The Lord will hear when I call to him.
Be angry, but do not sin. Speak in your hearts, and meditate on your beds.
Offer sacrifices of righteousness, and put your hope in the Lord.
Many say, “Who will show us what is good and spread the light of his face over us?”
Lord, you have put your joy in my heart, more than when their grain, wine, and oil increased.
In peace I will lie down and fall asleep at once, for you, Lord, let me live alone in quiet.
Listen to my words, Lord, and understand my meditation.
Listen to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for it is to you that I pray.
Lord, in the morning you will hear my voice; in the morning I will prepare myself and appear before you.
For you are God and do not desire wickedness; evil will not dwell with you.
The boastful will not stand before your eyes. You hate all who practice deceit.
You will destroy those who speak lies. The Lord will reject the bloodthirsty and deceitful person.
But I, through your abundant grace, will enter your house and worship in your holy temple.
In reverence for you, Lord, guide me; and in your righteousness, because of my enemies, make your way straight before me.
For there is no honesty in their mouths, but injustice is within them. Their throats are like open graves, and they use their tongues deceitfully.
May God condemn them, and may they fall through their own counsels. Drive them away because of their many injustices, for they have provoked you.
May all who hope in you rejoice and praise you forever. May you dwell in them, and may all who love your name be strengthened in you.
For you bless the righteous, Lord; you will surround me with favor as with a shield.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your fury.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak. Heal me, Lord, for my bones are shaken.
My soul is deeply shaken. And you, Lord—how long?
Turn back, Lord, and rescue my soul. Save me because of your grace.
For in death there is no remembrance of you, and in Sheol who gives you thanks?
I have grown weary with my sighing. Every night I soak my bed and drench my couch with my tears.
My eye aches from anger and is troubled because of all my enemies.
Keep away from all who practice deceit, for the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
The Lord has heard my plea; the Lord has accepted my prayer.
May all my enemies be ashamed and utterly shattered. May they turn back and perish suddenly.
Lord my God, I have put my hope in you. Save me and rescue me from all who pursue me.
Lest he tear me apart like a lion, with no one to rescue or deliver me.
LORD my God, if I have done this, if there is wrongdoing in my hands,
if I have repaid the one who did evil to me, or oppressed my enemy without cause,
let the enemy pursue me and overtake me; let him trample my life into the ground and lay my glory in the dust.
Rise, LORD, in your anger; lift yourself up over the necks of my enemies. Awake on my behalf for the judgment you have commanded.
Let the assembly of nations surround you, and for its sake return to the heights.
The LORD will judge the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness and my integrity.
Let evil bring the wicked to an end, and establish the righteous. The righteous God tests hearts and innermost thoughts.
My helper is God, who saves the upright in heart.
God is a just judge; he is not angry every day.
If he does not turn back, he will sharpen his sword; he has drawn his bow and made it ready.
He prepares weapons of wrath for him; he has made his arrows burn.
For he became pregnant with injustice, conceived falsehood, and gave birth to wrongdoing.
He dug a pit and hollowed it out, and fell into the hole he had made.
His wrongdoing will return upon his own head, and his injustice will come down upon his own crown.
I will give thanks to the LORD according to my righteousness, and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
Lord, our Lord, how glorious is your name throughout the earth! You have placed your glory above the heavens.
From the mouths of youths and children you have established your praise because of your enemies, so that the vengeful enemy may be stopped.
For they have seen your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars that you established.
What is man that you remember him, or a human being that you care for him?
You made him a little lower than the angels; you clothed him with honor and glory.
You gave him authority over the work of your hands; you placed everything beneath his feet:
all sheep and cattle, and also the wild animals,
the birds in the sky, and the fish of the sea that travel along the paths of the seas.
LORD, our Lord, how glorious is your name throughout the earth!
I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart, and recount all your wonders.
I will be glad and rejoice in you, and I will sing praise to your name, Most High.
When my enemies turn back, they will stumble and perish before you.
For you have upheld my cause and my right, and you have sat on the throne as a righteous judge.
You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their names forever and ever.
My enemies have come to an end by the sword forever. You have uprooted cities and destroyed their memory.
But the Lord remains forever, and his throne is established for judgment,
so that he may judge the world in truth and the nations with fairness.
The Lord will be a refuge for the poor and their helper in times of distress.
All who know your name will trust in you, because you do not abandon those who seek you, Lord.
Sing praise to the Lord, who dwells in Zion, and proclaim his deeds among the nations.
For he has remembered to avenge their blood and has not forgotten the cry of the poor.
Have mercy on me, Lord, and see the oppression I suffer from those who hate me, you who lift me up from the gates of death.
So that I may recount all your wonders at the gates of daughter Zion, I will rejoice in your salvation.
The nations have sunk into the pit they made, and their foot has been caught in the trap they hid.
The Lord makes known the judgment he has carried out, and the wicked person is caught by the work of his own hands.
The wicked will return to Sheol, along with all the nations that forget God.
For the poor will not be forgotten forever, and the hope of the poor will never perish.
Rise up, Lord, and do not let mortal humanity prevail. Let the nations be judged before you.
Appoint a lawgiver over them, so that the nations may know that they are human.
Why, Lord, do you stand far away and turn your gaze away in times of distress?
In the wicked person's arrogance, the poor person burns. Let them be caught in the scheme they devised.
For the wicked person boasts of his own desires; the evildoer receives blessings and provokes the Lord.
In his arrogance, the wicked person does not seek God, and God is absent from all his thoughts.
His ways are always perverse, and your judgment is far above his reach. He despises all his enemies.
He says in his heart, “I will not be shaken for generations to come.” He plots evil.
His mouth is full of curses, deceit, and treachery. Under his tongue are wrongdoing and oppression.
He sits in ambush in the settlement, and in hiding he kills the righteous. His eyes watch the unfortunate.
He lies in wait to seize the poor by drawing in his net.
He will be brought low and fall, and sickness and pain will be in his bones.
He says in his heart, “God has forgotten; he has turned his face away and will never see.”
Rise up, LORD my God, and lift up your hand. Do not forget the afflicted.
Why has the sinner provoked God and said in his heart, “You will not call me to account”?
You see that there is injustice and anger, and you watch so that it may be entrusted to your hands. The afflicted person entrusts himself to you, and you are the orphan’s helper.
Break the arm of the sinner and the wicked person. Let his sin be sought out until it can no longer be found.
The LORD is king forever and ever. The nations have perished from his land.
You hear the hope of the poor, LORD, and your ear listens to the resolve of their hearts.
To give justice to the orphan and the afflicted, so that he may no longer destroy human beings from the earth.
I have trusted in the Lord. How can you say to my soul, "Flee and settle on the mountains like a bird"?
For look, sinners have drawn the bow and set their arrows on the string to shoot in the darkness at the upright in heart.
For they have torn down what you prepared. But what has the righteous person done?
The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD’s throne is in heaven. His eyes see, and his eyelids examine human beings.
The LORD examines the righteous. He hates the unjust and those who love injustice.
Snares fell on the wicked like rain. Fire and sulfur and a devastating wind are the portion of their cup.
For the LORD is righteous and loves righteousness, and his face beholds uprightness.
Save us, LORD, for the good person is gone, and faithfulness has vanished from the earth [?] humankind.
They speak empty words, each to his neighbor. With deceitful lips and a double heart they speak.
May the LORD destroy all deceitful lips and tongues that speak boastfully.
They said, "We will make our tongue mighty. Our lips are our own. Who is our master?"
“Because the poor are plundered and the afflicted groan, I will now rise up,” says the LORD, “and openly bring deliverance.”
The LORD’s word is a pure word, choice silver tested in the earth and purified seven times.
You, LORD, will guard them. Save me and deliver me from this generation forever.
The wicked roam about and walk according to the vile arrogance of the descendants of Edom.
How long will you forget me, LORD? Forever? How long will you turn your face away from me?
How long will you place sorrow in my soul and grief in my heart every day? How long will my enemy exalt himself over me?
Look and answer me, Lord my God, and give light to my eyes so that I do not sleep in death.
Do not let my enemy say, “I have defeated him,” or let my oppressors rejoice over me when I am shaken.
But I have trusted in your goodness. My heart will rejoice in your salvation, and I will praise the LORD, who has saved me.
The wicked man said in his heart, “There is no God.” They have become corrupt and defiled through their deeds, and there is no one who does good.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon human beings to see whether anyone had understanding and sought God.
They have all turned aside and together become loathsome. There is no one who does good, not even one.
Have all those who do evil not understood? They eat my people as they eat bread, and they have not called on the Lord.
There they were overcome with fear, because God is among the righteous generation.
You have put the poor person's plan to shame, because the Lord is his refuge.
Who will bring salvation to Israel from Zion? When the Lord brings back his people's captives, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
Lord, who may live in your tent? Who may dwell on your holy mountain?
The one who walks without fault, does what is right, and speaks the truth in his heart;
who is not deceitful with his tongue, does no evil to his companion, and accepts no bribe against his neighbor;
who despises the person who provokes anger but honors those who fear the Lord; who swears an oath to his companion and does not lie;
who does not lend his money at interest and takes no bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things stands firm and will never be shaken.
Protect me, God, because I have put my trust in you.
I said to the Lord, “You are my Lord, and my good comes from you.”
Also to the holy ones who are in the land, the glorious ones in whom is all my delight.
The pains of others will quickly increase. I will not pour out their offerings of blood or mention their names with my lips.
The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup. You restore my inheritance to me.
The measuring lines have fallen for me in [?]. My inheritance, too, is pleasing to me.
I will bless the Lord who has counseled me; even at night my innermost being corrects me.
I have set the Lord before me at all times, and he is at my right hand so that I will not be shaken.
Because of this my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; my flesh too will dwell in peace.
For you have not abandoned my soul in Sheol, nor have you allowed your faithful one to see decay.
You will show me your path of life, and I will be filled with the joy of your presence and with the sweetness of the victory of your right hand.
Listen, holy Lord, and look upon my plea. Listen to my prayer, which does not come from deceitful lips.
Let my judgment come from you, and let your eyes see what is right.
You examined my heart and visited me at night. You tested me and found no wrongdoing in me, and they did not pass my lips.
The deeds of human beings, through the speech of lips—but you have kept me from evil paths.
You have steadied my steps in your paths so that my footsteps will not falter.
I have called on you because you have answered me, God. Turn your ear toward me and hear my words.
Perform a wonder for your faithful ones, O Savior of those who hope, against those who stand opposed to your right hand.
Guard me like the pupil of the eye, and hide me in the shadow of your wings.
From the sinners who have plundered me, and from the enemies of my life who have set themselves against me.
Shut their mouths, which have spoken arrogantly.
They praised me, and now they have surrounded me. They have set their eyes on throwing me to the ground.
They are like a lion seeking to break its prey, and like a young lion sitting in hiding.
Rise, Lord, confront them and bring them to their knees. Rescue my soul from the wicked and from the sword.

And from the dead who die by your hands, Lord, and from the dead of the pit—you will separate them among the living. Fill their bellies with your treasures. Let the children be satisfied and leave the remainder to their children.
But I will see your face in righteousness, and when I awake I will be satisfied with your faithfulness.
I love you, Lord, my strength.
And my confidence, my refuge, my deliverer, the mighty God in whom I trust, my helper, the horn of my salvation, and my refuge.
I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy of praise, and I will be saved from my enemies.
For the cords of death surrounded me, and the deceits of the wicked terrified me.
The cords of Sheol encircled me, and the snares of death confronted me.
In my distress I called to the Lord, and I called to my God. From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry came before him and entered his ears.
The earth shook and trembled, and the foundations of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry with them.
Smoke rose in his anger, and fire blazed from his face; coals burned from it.
He bent the heavens and came down, with thick darkness beneath his feet.
He rode upon cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness his hiding place, and his shelter surrounded him: dark waters in the clouds of the sky.
From the brightness of his shelter he made his clouds into hail and coals of fire.
The Lord thundered in heaven, and the Most High gave his voice: hail and coals of fire.
He sent out his arrows and scattered them; he multiplied his lightning flashes and threw them into confusion.
The springs of water appeared, and the foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the wind of your anger.
He reached down from on high and drew me up; he took me out of many waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemies and from those who hated me, for they were stronger than I.
They confronted me on the day of my distress, but the Lord became my deliverer.
He brought me out into a spacious place and rescued me because he delighted in me.
The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; he repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
For I have kept the ways of the Lord and have not rebelled against my God.
For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put his laws away from me.
I was blameless before him and guarded myself against my sins.
The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness and according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
With the faithful you will be faithful, and with the blameless you will show yourself blameless.
With the pure you will show yourself pure, and with the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
For you will save a poor people, but you will bring down haughty eyes.
You will light my lamp; the Lord my God will light up my darkness.
For through you I will charge against a troop, and through my God I will leap over a wall.
God's way is blameless; the word of the Lord is tested, and he helps all who trust in him.
For there is no God apart from the Lord, and no one is mighty like our God.
God girded me with strength and made my way blameless.
He made my feet like those of a deer and set me on my heights.
He trained my hands for battle and made my arms strong like a bronze bow.
You gave me the shield of salvation. Your right hand will support me, and your discipline will make me great.
You made room for my steps beneath me so that my ankles would not give way.
I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until I have finished them off.
I will strike them down, and they will not be able to rise; they will fall beneath my feet.
You will gird me with strength for battle and make those who rise against me kneel beneath me.
You will break my enemies before me, and I will silence those who hate me.
They will cry out, but there will be no one to save them; they will appeal to the Lord, but he will not answer them.
I will crush them like dust before the wind and trample them like mud in the streets.
You will rescue me from the disputes of the people and make me head over the nations; a people I have not known will serve me.
As soon as they hear me, they will obey me; foreigners will submit to me.
Foreigners will falter and limp away from their paths.
The Lord lives! Blessed is the one who strengthens me! May my God and my Savior be exalted!
God gives me vengeance and subdues the nations under me.
Rescue me from my enemies; lift me above those who rise against me, and deliver me from unjust men.
Therefore I will thank you among the nations, my Lord, and sing praises to your name.
He grants great deliverance to his king and shows kindness to his anointed one, to David and his descendants forever.
The heavens declare the glory of God, and the sky proclaims the work of his hands.
Day pours out speech to day, and night reveals knowledge to night.
There is no speech and there are no words whose voice is not heard.
Their message has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world. In them he pitched his tent for the sun.
It is like a bridegroom coming out of his bridal chamber; it rejoices like a mighty man running his course.
It rises from the ends of heaven and sets at the ends of heaven, and nothing is hidden from its heat.
The law of the Lord is without blemish and restores the soul. The testimony of the Lord is trustworthy and makes children wise.
The precepts of the Lord are upright and gladden the heart. The commandment of the Lord is excellent and enlightens the eyes.
The fear of the Lord is pure and endures forever. The judgments of the Lord are true and righteous in every respect.
They are more desirable than gold and precious stones, and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
Your servant, too, will take warning from them; if he keeps them, he will be richly rewarded.
Who can recognize errors? Clear me of hidden faults.
Keep your servant also from wrongdoing, so that the wicked may not rule over me, and I may be cleansed of my sins.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing before you, Lord, my helper and my Savior.
May the Lord answer you on the day of distress, and may the name of the God of Jacob help you.
May he send you help from his sanctuary and support you from Zion.
May the Lord remember all your offerings and accept your burnt offerings.
May the Lord grant you what your heart desires and fulfill all your plans.
We will give praise for your deliverance and be lifted up in the name of our God. May the Lord fulfill all your desires.
Now it is known that God has saved his anointed one and answered him from his holy heaven with the saving might of his right hand.
These rely on chariots and those on horses, but we will be strong in the name of the Lord our God.
They knelt down and fell, but we rose and made ourselves ready.
May the Lord save us, and may our king answer us on the day we call to him.
Lord, the king will rejoice in your strength and delight greatly in your deliverance.
You have given him his heart’s desire and have not withheld what his lips requested.
For you met him with good blessings and placed a glorious crown on his head.
He asked you for life, and you gave him length of days forever and ever.
His glory will grow great through your deliverance; you have bestowed glory and splendor on him.
For you have made him a blessing forever and ever, and you have made him glad with the joy of your presence.
For the king trusts in the Lord; through the goodness of the Most High he will not be shaken.
Your hand will find all your enemies, and your right hand will find those who hate you.
You will make them like a fiery furnace at the time of wrath. The Lord will burn them in his anger, and fire will consume them.
You will destroy their fruit from the earth and their offspring from among humankind.
For they directed evil against you and devised a plan, but they lacked the strength to carry it out.
You will put a mark on them and direct what you have prepared at their faces.
Be exalted, Lord, in your strength! We will sing and praise your might.
My God, my God, why have you abandoned me and stayed far from saving me, because of the words of my foolishness?
My God, I call to you by day, but you do not answer me, and by night, but you do not stay with me.
You are holy and dwell in your glory, Israel.
My ancestors trusted in you; they trusted in you, and you rescued them.
They cried out to you and were rescued; they trusted in you and were not put to shame.
But I am a worm, not a human being, scorned by humankind and despised by the people.
All who saw me mocked me; they sneered with their lips and shook their heads.
“He trusted in the Lord; let him rescue him and deliver him, if he delights in him.”
For you have been my confidence from the womb and my hope at my mother’s breasts.
I was cast upon you from the womb; from my mother’s womb you have been my God.
Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
Many bulls have surrounded me; wild bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
They opened their mouths against me like a lion that roars and tears its prey.
I was poured out like water, and all my bones were scattered. My heart became like wax and melted within my bowels.
My strength dried up like a shard of pottery, and my tongue stuck to the roof of my mouth. You cast me onto the dust of death.
For dogs surrounded me, and a gathering of evildoers encircled me. They pierced my hands and my feet.
All my bones wailed. They stared and looked at me.
They divided my clothes among themselves and cast lots for my garment.
But you, Lord, do not be far from me. O God, O God, remain to help me.
Rescue my life from the sword, my only life from the power of the dogs.
Save me from the lion’s mouth, and my lowly self from the lofty horn.
Then I will proclaim your name to my brothers and praise you in the midst of the assembly.
You who fear the Lord, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Fear him, all you descendants of Israel!
For he did not despise or reject the poor man’s cry, nor did he turn his face away from him. When he cried out to him, he heard him.
My praise in the great assembly comes from you. I will fulfill my vows before those who fear him.
The poor will eat and be satisfied. Those who seek the Lord will praise him, and their hearts will live forever.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the families of the nations will bow down before him.
For kingship belongs to the Lord, and he rules over the nations.
All the hungry people of the earth will eat and bow down before the Lord. All who go down to the dust will kneel before him. My soul lives for him.
The offspring who will serve him will proclaim his generation to the Lord.
They will come and declare his righteousness to a people yet to be born, whom the Lord has made.
The Lord will shepherd me, and I will lack nothing.
He will settle me in rich pastures and lead me beside peaceful waters.
Restore my soul and lead me along paths of truth for your name’s sake.
Even if I walk through valleys of the shadows of death, I will fear no evil, because you are with me. Your rod and your staff comfort me.
You arranged tables before me in the presence of my enemies. You anointed my head with oil, and my cup intoxicates like undiluted wine.
Your goodness and your mercy pursued me all the days of my life, so that I may dwell in the Lord’s house for length of days.
The earth belongs to the Lord, with everything in it, the world and all its inhabitants.
For he laid its foundations upon the sea and established it upon the rivers.
Who will ascend the Lord’s mountain, and who will stand on his holy mountain?
The one whose hands are clean and whose heart is pure, who does not swear falsely by his own life and does not swear deceitfully.
This person will receive a blessing from the Lord and righteousness from God our Savior.
This is the generation that seeks and waits for your presence, O God of Jacob.
Lift up your heads, gates! Be lifted up, ancient gates, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord, mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient gates, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? The mighty Lord—he is the glorious King forever.
To you, Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
My God, I have trusted in you. Let me not be put to shame, so that my enemies may not boast over me.
Indeed, let none who hope in you be put to shame. Let the wicked be ashamed of their empty pursuits.
Show me your ways, Lord, and make your paths known to me.
Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you are my God and my Savior, and I wait for you all day long.
Remember, Lord, your mercies from long ago and your acts of kindness.
Do not remember against me the sins of my youth, but remember me according to your abundant mercy, because of your goodness, O God.
The Lord is good and upright; therefore he sets sinners on the right path.
He guides the humble in justice and teaches the poor his way.
All the Lord’s ways are kindness and truth for those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.
For your name’s sake, Lord, forgive my wickedness, for it is great.
Who is the person who fears the Lord? He will teach him the way he should choose.
His soul will rest in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
The Lord’s counsel is for those who fear him, and he has made his covenant known to them.
My eyes are always toward the Lord, for he brings my feet out of the snare.
Turn toward me and have mercy on me, for I am alone and miserable.
The troubles of my heart have multiplied; bring me out of my distress.
Look at my oppression and my toil, and forgive all my sin.
See how my enemies have multiplied, and how they hate me with unjust hatred.
Guard my life and rescue me, because I have put my hope in you.
The blameless and upright have joined me, because I have waited for you.
O God, redeem Israel from all his troubles.
Vindicate me, Lord, because I have walked in my integrity. I have put my hope in the Lord; I will not be shaken.
Examine me, Lord, and test me; try my innermost being and my heart.
For your mercies are before my eyes; I have walked in faithfulness.
I have not sat with evildoers, nor have I gone in with fools.
I hate the gathering of evildoers, and I have not sat with the wicked.
I have washed my hands in purity and walked around your altar, Lord,
to make the sound of your praise heard and recount all your wonders.
Lord, I love the service of your house and the place where your glory dwells.
Do not destroy me with sinners, or my life with bloodthirsty men,
whose hands hold deceit and whose right hands are full of bribes.
But I have walked in my integrity; redeem me and have mercy on me.
My foot stands in uprightness, and in the assembly I will bless the Lord.
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom should I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life; whom should I dread?
When evildoers approached me to eat my flesh, my enemies and those who hated me stumbled and fell together.
If an army camps against me, my heart will not fear. If war rises against me, even then I am confident.
One thing I have asked of the Lord, and this is what I seek: to dwell in the Lord’s house all the days of my life, to gaze upon the Lord’s beauty and visit his temple.
For he will hide me in his shelter on the day of trouble; he will hide me in the shade of his tabernacle and lift me up onto a rock.
Now my head will be lifted above my enemies who surround me, and I will offer sacrifices of praise in his tabernacle. I will praise and sing to the Lord.
Hear my voice, Lord, when I call to you; have mercy on me and answer me.
My heart speaks to you, and my face seeks your face.
Lord, do not turn your face away from me, and do not afflict your servant in anger. You have been my helper, Lord; do not cast me away or abandon me, my God and my Savior.
For my father and mother have abandoned me, but the Lord has taken me in.
Teach me your way, Lord, and lead me along your straight paths.
Do not hand me over to my enemies, for false witnesses have risen against me and spoken unjustly.
But I have believed that I will see the Lord’s goodness in the land of the living.
Hope in the Lord, and let your hearts grow strong. Hope in the Lord.
To you, Lord, I have called. My God, do not be silent toward me, lest you be silent toward me and I be handed over with those who go down to the pit.
Hear the sound of my plea when I cry out to you, when I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
Do not count me among the wicked and those who do evil, who speak peace with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.
Repay them according to their deeds and according to their wickedness.
Because they have not understood the Lord’s deeds or the work of his hands, he will tear them down and not build them up.
Blessed is the Lord, who has heard the sound of my plea.
The Lord is my help and my support. My heart trusted in him, and my flesh flourished. I will thank him with praise.
The Lord is the strength of his people, the helper and savior of his anointed one.
Save your people and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and lead them forever.
Bring young rams to the Lord. Bring glory and honor to the Lord.
Bring to the Lord the honor due his name. Worship the Lord in his holy court.
The Lord’s voice is over the waters. The glorious God thunders; the Lord is over the mighty waters.
The Lord’s voice is powerful, and the Lord’s voice is glorious.
The Lord’s voice tears up cedars; the Lord breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes them dance like calves, Lebanon and Senir like young wild oxen.
The Lord’s voice splits the flame of fire.
The Lord’s voice shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
The Lord’s voice makes the deer tremble and uproots the forests. In his temple everyone says, “Glory!”
The Lord turned back the flood; the Lord sits as King forever.
The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.
I will exalt you, Lord, because you have lifted me up and have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
Lord my God, I pleaded with you, and you healed me.
You brought my soul up from Sheol and kept me alive from among those who go down to the pit.
Sing to the Lord, his chosen ones, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
For there is rebuke in his anger and life in his favor. Weeping will stay for the evening, but joy will come in the morning.
I said in my ease, “I will never be shaken.”
God, by your favor you made my glory strong. You turned your face away, and I trembled.
I called to you, Lord, and pleaded with you, my Lord.
What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to destruction? The dust does not thank you or proclaim your faithfulness.
Hear, God, and have mercy on me. Lord, be my helper.
For you turned my mourning into joy; you untied my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness.
Therefore I will sing praise to you and will not be silent. Lord my God, I will thank you forever.
In you, Lord, I have placed my hope; may I never be put to shame. Deliver me in your righteousness.
Turn your ear toward me and answer me quickly. Be a helping God and a place of refuge for me, and save me.
For you are my strength and my refuge. For your name’s sake, Lord, comfort me.
Bring me out of this net that they have hidden for me, for you are my helper.
I entrusted my spirit to you, and you redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.
I hate those who give heed to worthless idols, but I have placed my hope in you, Lord.
I will rejoice and be glad in your goodness, for you have seen my affliction and known the distress of my soul.
You have not handed me over to my enemies; you have set my feet in a spacious place.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am in distress. My eye is troubled by anger, as are my soul and my body.
For my life is spent in sorrow and my years in sighing. My strength has weakened through poverty, and my bones are troubled.
Because of all my enemies, I have become a disgrace to my neighbors and a terror to those who know me. Those who saw me in the street fled from me.
I have been forgotten like someone dead, gone from memory, and I have become like a lost vessel.
For I heard the whispering of many as they conspired together against me and plotted to take my life.
But I have trusted in you, Lord, and said, “You are my God, Lord.”
The times are in your hands. Save me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
Make your face shine upon your servant, and save me by your grace.
Lord, may I not be put to shame, for I have called to you. Let the wicked be put to shame and go down to Sheol.
Let the lips of the unjust be shut, for they speak falsehood and contempt against the righteous.
How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, for those who hope in you before all people!
You hide them in the shelter of your presence from the turmoil people cause; you shelter them in your shade from strife.
Blessed is the Lord, who has chosen his chosen ones for himself in a fortified city.
In my haste I said, “I have perished from your sight.” Yet you heard the sound of my plea when I called to you.
Love the Lord, you his righteous ones. The Lord protects the faithful and repays the wicked for their deeds.
Be strong, and let your hearts be courageous, all you who hope in the Lord.
Blessed is the one whose wrongdoing is forgiven and whose sins are covered.
Blessed is the person whose sin the Lord does not count against him, and in whose heart there is no deceit.
Because I kept silent, my bones wasted away while I groaned all day long.
For night and day your hand was heavy upon me, and pain churned in my chest to kill me.
I made my sins known to you and did not hide my offenses from you. I said, “I will confess my offenses to the Lord,” and you forgive me all my sins.
For this reason, let everyone chosen for you pray to you at an acceptable time. Then the flood of mighty waters will not come near him.
You shelter me and protect me from my enemies. Surround me with praise and deliverance.
To give you understanding, I will show you the way you should go and keep my eye on you.
Do not be like the horse and the mule, which have no understanding, which are restrained with a bridle from their youth and do not come near him.
The wicked have many pains, but goodness will surround whoever hopes in the Lord.
Rejoice, you righteous, and delight in the Lord. Praise him, all you who are upright in heart.
Praise the Lord, you righteous. Praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to him with the lyre; make music to him on a ten-stringed harp.
Sing him a new song of praise, and sing beautifully aloud.
For the Lord’s word is upright, and all his deeds are done in faithfulness.
He loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of the Lord’s goodness.
By the Lord’s word the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all their hosts.
He gathered the waters of the sea as though into waterskins and put the deep into storehouses.
Let the whole earth fear the Lord, and let all the world’s inhabitants tremble before him.
For he spoke, and they came into being; he commanded and established them.
The Lord frustrates the counsel of the nations, and the Lord frustrates the plans of the peoples.
The Lord’s purpose stands forever, and the plans of his heart endure through all generations.
Blessed is the people whose God is the Lord, the people he has chosen as his own inheritance.
The Lord looked down from heaven and saw all human beings.
From his dwelling place he saw all the inhabitants of the earth.
He formed all their hearts and understands all their deeds.
A king is not saved by a large army, nor is a warrior rescued by his great strength.
The rescue a horse promises is deceptive, for despite its great strength it cannot rescue its rider.
The Lord’s eyes are on the righteous, who wait for his goodness,
to rescue their lives from death and keep them alive during famine.
Our soul has waited for the Lord, because he is our helper and our support.
Our heart will rejoice in him, because we have placed our hope in his holy name.
May your goodness be upon us, Lord, just as we have waited for you.
I will bless the Lord at all times, and his praises will always be in my mouth.
My soul will boast in the Lord; let the poor hear and rejoice.
Magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.
I sought the Lord, and he answered me and rescued me from all my troubles.
Look to him and place your hope in him, and your faces will not be put to shame.
This is the poor man who called to him, and he heard him and rescued him from all his troubles.
The camp of the Lord’s angels surrounds those who fear him and rescues them.
Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed are all who trust in him.
The rich became poor and went hungry, but those who seek the Lord will lack no good thing.
Come, children, listen to me, and I will teach you the fear of God.
Who is the person who desires life and loves to see good days?
Keep your tongue from evil, and do not let your lips speak deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
The Lord’s eyes are on the righteous, and his ears are ready to hear them.
The face of the Lord is against evildoers, to wipe out their memory from the earth.
The righteous cried out, and the Lord heard them and rescued them.
The Lord is near to the brokenhearted, and he saves the humble in spirit.
The troubles of the righteous person are many, but the Lord rescues him from them all.
He guards all his bones, so that not one of them will be broken.
Evil kills the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will perish.
The Lord will save the lives of his servants, and none who put their hope in him will be condemned.
Lord, plead my case, and fight against those who fight against me.
Take up weapons and a shield, and rise to help me.
Draw your sword and make it flash against my pursuers, and say to my soul, “I am your savior.”
Let those who seek my life be ashamed and disgraced. Let those who plotted evil against me turn back and be disgraced.
Let them be like dust before the wind, and let the Lord’s angel pursue them.
Let their path grow dark and become slippery, and let the angel of God pursue them.
For they hid snares for me and spread a net for my life.
Let disaster come upon them suddenly. Let the net they hid catch them, and let them fall into the pit they dug.
But my soul will rejoice in God and delight in his salvation.
All my bones will say, “Lord, who is like you? You rescue the afflicted from their enemy, and the poor and afflicted from those who rob them by force.”
Unjust witnesses rose up and questioned me about things I knew nothing about.
They repaid me evil for good and cut my life off from other people.
But when they were sick, I wore sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting, and my prayer returned to my own breast.
I went about as a friend and a brother, and I grieved like someone sitting in mourning.
In my suffering they gathered and rejoiced over me. They gathered against me for a long time, and I did not know.
In their pride and mockery, they gnashed their teeth at me.
My Lord, you have now seen it. Rescue my life from their turmoil, and my only life from the lions.
I will thank you in the great assembly, and among many peoples I will sing praises to you.
Do not let my enemies rejoice over me, or the liars who hate me without cause and wink their eyes.
They do not speak peace, but plot deceit against the humble of the earth.
They opened their mouths against me and said, “Aha! Aha! Our eyes have seen it!”
You have seen it, God. Do not be silent, my Lord, and do not be far from me.
Awake to judge my case, my God and my Lord, and see the wrong done to me.
Judge me according to your righteousness, LORD, so that they may not rejoice over me.
Let them not say in their hearts, “We are satisfied, and we have drowned him!”
Let those who desire my harm be ashamed and disgraced together, and let those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame.
Let those who desire my vindication offer praise and rejoice. Let them always say, “Great is the LORD, who desires the well-being of his servant!”
My tongue will give thanks for your righteousness and praise you all day long.
The wicked person plans evil in his heart, because the fear of God is not before his eyes.
For he finds it hateful to abandon his sins and hate them.
The words of his mouth are harmful and deceitful, and he has no desire to do good.
He plans harm on his bed and walks on a path that is not good, intending to do evil.
LORD, your mercy is in the heavens, and your faithfulness reaches to the highest heavens.
Your righteousness is like the mountains, God, and your judgments are like the great deep. You save humans and animals, Lord.
How abundant is your mercy, God! People take shelter in the shadow of your wings.
They will drink their fill from the abundance of your house, and you will give them drink from your delightful stream.
For the fountain of life is with you, and in your light we see light.
Preserve your mercy for those close to you, and your righteousness for the upright in heart.
Do not let a mighty foot come against us, and do not let the hand of the wicked drive us away.
For there all who practice falsehood fall; they are thrown down and cannot rise.
Do not envy the wicked or be jealous of those who do wrong.
For they quickly dry up like grass and wither like green plants.
Trust in God and do good. Live in the land and seek faithfulness.
Put your hope in the LORD, and he will grant you the requests of your heart.
Set your path straight before the LORD and trust in him, and he will act.
He will bring forth your righteousness like the light and your just judgments like midday.
Ask of the LORD and pray before him. Do not envy the person who does wrong and whose path prospers.
Leave off anger and leave off wrath. Do not become envious and do evil.
For the wicked will perish, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.
In a little while you will look for the wicked person, and he will be gone. You will look at his place, but he will not be found.
The poor will inherit the land and delight in abundant peace.
The wicked person grows angry with the righteous person and gnashes his teeth at him.
But the Lord will laugh at him, because he knows that his day has come.
The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to kill the poor, the evil, and those whose ways are upright.
Their sword will enter their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
A little belonging to a righteous person is better than the great wealth of the wicked.
For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the Lord supports the righteous.
The Lord knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
They will not be put to shame in an evil time, and in days of famine they will have enough to eat.
For the wicked perish, and the Lord’s enemies, the fattened ones, come to an end; like smoke they vanish.
The wicked person borrows and does not repay, but the righteous person shows mercy and gives.
For those blessed by the Lord will inherit the land, but those cursed by him will perish.
A person’s steps are made firm by the Lord, and he sets his path straight.
For even if he falls, he will not be hurt, because the Lord holds his hand.
I was young and have grown old, yet I have not seen a righteous person forsaken or his descendants begging for bread.
Instead, he shows mercy and lends all day long, and his descendants are blessed.
Turn away from evil and do good; rest forever.
For the Lord loves justice and does not forsake his righteous ones. Instead, he protects them forever, but destroys the descendants of the wicked.
The righteous will inherit the land and live in it forever.
The mouth of the righteous person speaks wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
The law of God is in his heart, and his steps do not falter.
The wicked person lies in wait for the righteous person and seeks to kill him.
The Lord will not leave him in his hands, but will condemn him in judgment.
Hope in the Lord and keep his way, and he will raise you up to inherit the land. You will see when the wicked are destroyed.
For I saw the wicked boasting and towering like trees in a forest.
When I passed by, he was gone. I looked for him but could not find him.
Maintain integrity and choose uprightness, because there is a good end for people of peace.
Sinners will perish together, and the end of the wicked is destruction.
The Lord is the savior of the righteous; he helps them in times of distress.
The Lord helps them and delivers them. He delivers them from the wicked and saves them because they have hoped in him.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your fury.
For your arrows have lodged in me, and your hand has rested upon me.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your anger, and there is no peace in my bones because of my sins.
For my sins have gone over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
My wounds have rotted and become foul because of my foolish acts.
I trembled greatly, and all day long I walked about in mourning.
For my ankles are filled with trembling, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
I trembled and became very weak, and I groaned because of the roaring of my heart.
Lord, all my longing lies before you, and my sighs are not hidden from you.
My heart was in turmoil, my strength deserted me, and the light of my eyes was no longer with me.
My friends and companions stood facing my affliction, and my relatives stood far away.
Those who seek my life seized me. They desire my harm and speak lies, and all day long they devise deceit.
But I was like a deaf person, not hearing, and like someone unable to speak, I did not open my mouth.
I became like a man who does not hear and has no rebuke in his mouth.
For I waited for you, Lord, and you answered me, Lord my God.
For I said, “Do not let them rejoice over me or exalt themselves over me when my feet slip.”
For I am ready for suffering, and my pain is always before me.
For I will show you my foolish acts and be cleansed of my sins.
My enemies grew strong and saw, and those who hated me falsely became numerous.
They repaid me evil for good and opposed me because I sought what was good.
Do not abandon me, Lord my God, and do not be far from me.
Instead, continue to help me and save me.
I said, “I will guard my ways so that I do not sin with my tongue. I will guard my mouth from wrongdoing because of the wicked who stand against me.”
I was silent and sorrowful; I suffered for lack of good, and my pain was stirred up.
My heart grew hot within me, and fire took hold in my body. I expressed my thoughts with my tongue:
“Lord, show me my end and the measure of my days, so that I may know how much time I have left.
Look, you have given my days a fixed measure, and my remaining life is like nothing before you. All human beings stand like a breath.
A person walks about like a shadow and busies himself like a breath. He piles up treasures without knowing for whom he is gathering them.
Now, who is my hope except you, Lord?
Rescue me from all my offenses, and do not make me an object of scorn to the wicked.
I was silent and did not open my mouth, because you did it.
Remove your scourge from me; I am worn out by the blows of your hands.
With rebukes for his sins you discipline a person, and you make what he treasures disappear like a moth. All human beings are like a breath.
Hear my prayer and my plea, Lord; listen to my tears and do not remain silent. For I am a foreigner with you, a temporary resident like all my ancestors.
Rescue me so that I may find relief before I go away and am no more.”
I waited expectantly for the Lord, and he turned toward me and heard my plea.
He brought me up from the pit of misery and from the mud of destruction. He set my feet on a rock and made my steps secure.
He put a new song of praise in my mouth, praise to God, so that many would see and rejoice and put their hope in the Lord.
Blessed is the person who trusts in the name of the Lord and does not turn to emptiness or to false speech.
Many are the things you have done, Lord our God—your wonders and your thoughts toward us. There is no one like you. I have declared and spoken of them, but they are too many to count.
You did not desire sacrifices and offerings, but you pierced ears for me. You did not ask for whole burnt offerings for sins.
Then I said, “Here I have come; at the beginning of the writings it is written about me.
I desire to do your will, God, and your law is deep within me.”
I proclaimed your righteousness in the great assembly. I did not restrain my lips; Lord, you know this.
I did not hide your righteousness within my heart, but spoke of your salvation and your faithfulness. I did not hide your kindness and your faithfulness from the great assembly.
You too, Lord, do not withhold your mercy from me. Rather, let your mercy and your faithfulness protect me at all times.
For evils beyond counting have surrounded me, and my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more numerous than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed me.
Be pleased, Lord, to rescue us. Lord, remain to help me.
Let those who seek to kill me be ashamed and disgraced. Let those who desire my harm turn back and be disgraced.
Let those who said of me, “Aha, aha!” be stunned by their repeated shame.
Let all who seek you rejoice in you, and let those who love your salvation always say, “The Lord is great!”
But I am poor and afflicted. My Lord, take thought of me. You are my helper and my deliverer; my God, do not delay.
Blessed is the one who considers the poor; the Lord will rescue him on the day of trouble.
The Lord will protect him and keep him alive, and will do him good in the land. He will not hand him over to his enemies.
The Lord will support him on his bed of pain and turn his whole bed in his illness.
I said, “You are my Lord. Have mercy on me and heal my soul, because I have sinned against you.”
My enemies spoke evil about me: “When will he die and his name perish?”
Whenever they came to see me, they spoke lies, while in their hearts they devised evil. Then they went out into the street and spoke about it.
All who hate me whispered together against me and plotted evil against me.
They were pondering a wicked word: “Now that he has lain down, he will never rise again.”
Even the man who greeted me in peace, whom I trusted, who ate my bread, whom I trusted, plotted greatly against me.
But you, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, so that I may repay them.
By this I know that you delight in me: my enemy does not harm me.
But you have supported me in my integrity and set me before you forever.
Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and amen.
As a deer cries out for streams of water, so my soul cries out to you, Lord.
My soul thirsts for you, the living God. When will I come and see your face, O God?
My tears have been my food day and night, while they said to me every day, “Where is your God?”
I remembered these things, and my soul was troubled, because I will pass through your mighty shelter to the house of God, with the sound of praise and thanksgiving, with many rejoicing.
Why are you troubled, my soul, and why are you bewildered? Wait for God, for I will again give thanks to him, the Savior of my countenance.
And my God, my soul is troubled within me. Therefore I remembered you from the land of the Jordan, from Hermon, and from the little mountain.
Deep calls to deep, one roar to another, in the waters of your cascades. All your breakers and your waves have passed over me.
By day the Lord will command his mercy, and by night his praises are with me—a prayer to the living God.
I said to God, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I walk in mourning under the oppression of my enemies?”
As my bones were breaking, my enemies taunted me. All day they said to me, “Where is your God?”
Why are you troubled, my soul, and why are you bewildered? Wait for God, for I will again praise him, the Savior of my countenance and my God.
Judge my case, God, and defend my cause against a merciless people. Rescue me from unjust and deceitful men.
For you are God, my strength. Why have you forgotten me? Why do I walk about mourning under the oppression of my enemies?
Send your light and your faithfulness; let them comfort me and bring me to your holy mountain and to your dwelling.
Then I will come to the altar of God, to God who makes my youth rejoice. I will praise you with the harp, God, my God.
Why are you troubled, my soul, and why are you sad? Wait for God, for I will again praise him, the Savior of my countenance and my God.
God, we have heard with our ears; our ancestors have also told us what you did in their days, in the days of old.
Your hand destroyed the nations and planted them; you afflicted kingdoms and established them.
For it was not by their sword that they inherited the land, nor did their own arm save them, but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you delighted in them.
You are God, my King, who commanded Jacob’s deliverance.
Through you we will pierce our enemies, and through your name we will trample those who hate us.
For we do not trust in our bows, nor in our weapons to save us.
You saved us from those who hated us and put our enemies to shame.
We have praised you, God, all day long, and we will give thanks to your name forever.
Now you have forgotten us and put us to shame, and you do not go out with our army.
Instead, you have turned us back, and our enemies have plundered us.
You have handed us over like sheep for food and scattered us among the nations.
You sold your people for nothing and gained no profit from their sale.
You have made us a disgrace to our neighbors, an object of ridicule and mockery to those around us.
You have made us a byword among the peoples, a cause for head-shaking among the nations.
My disgrace is before me all day long, and the shame of my face has covered me,
because of the voice of the one who insults and blasphemes, and because of the presence of the enemy who takes revenge.
All these things have happened to us, yet we have not forgotten you or been false to your covenant.
We have not turned back, nor have we turned our paths away from your way.
For you have brought us low in the place of the dragon and covered us with the shadows of death.
Yet we have not forgotten the name of our God or stretched out our hands to foreign gods.
God himself searches this out, for he knows the thoughts of the heart.
For your sake we are killed every day and considered like sheep for slaughter.
Wake up and do not sleep, Lord; remember us and do not forget us.
Do not turn your face away from us, and do not forget our humiliation and our afflictions.
For our soul has sunk down into the dust, and our belly clings to the ground.
Rise up, help me, and save me because of your mercy.
My heart overflows with good words; I speak of my works to the king. My tongue is the pen of a skilled scribe.
He is more handsome in appearance than other men. Grace has been poured over your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
Strap your sword to your waist, mighty warrior—your splendor and your glory.
And your glory is victorious. Ride on for the cause of truth, the humility of righteousness. Your law is in the fear of your right hand.
Your arrows are sharp, and peoples will fall beneath you, in the heart of the king’s enemies.
God’s throne is forever and ever; the scepter of your kingdom is an upright scepter.
You have loved righteousness and hated wrongdoing. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness more than your companions.
Myrrh, cassia, and fragrant oils perfume all your garments, from the chief palace; and from [?] they have made you glad.
The king’s daughter stood in glory, and the queen at your right hand, in clothing of gold from Ophir.
Listen, my daughter, and look; incline your ear, and forget your people and your father's house.
So that the king may desire your beauty. Because he is your lord, bow down to him.
The daughter of Tyre will bow down to him with offerings; the rich among the people will seek your favor.
All the glory of the king’s daughter is within, and her clothing is adorned with fine gold.
She will go to the king with offerings, and her virgin companions will be led along behind her.
They will go with joy and delight and enter the king’s palace.
Your sons will take the place of your fathers; make them rulers throughout the earth.
So that your name may be remembered in every generation. Therefore the peoples will give thanks to you forever and ever.
Our God is our strong refuge and our helper in times of distress. You have always been there for us.
Therefore we are not afraid when the earth shakes and the mountains tremble in the heart of the seas.
Let their waters churn and surge, and let the mountains shake at its might.
The currents of the rivers will bring joy in the city of our God. The dwelling place of the Most High is holy.
God is within her; she will not be shaken. God will help her at dawn.
The peoples were in turmoil, and kingdoms trembled. He raised his voice, and the earth shook.
The mighty Lord is with us, and the God of Jacob is our helper.
Come, see the works of God, who has done wonders on the earth.
He puts an end to wars to the ends of the earth. He breaks bows, shatters spears, and burns chariots with fire.
Be still and know that I am God. I am exalted among the nations; I am exalted on the earth.
The mighty Lord is with us, and the God of Jacob is our helper.
Clap your hands, all you peoples, and praise God with a voice of praise.
For the Lord is exalted and awe-inspiring; he is the great King over all the earth.
He subdued peoples beneath us and nations under our feet.
He chose us as his inheritance and as the glory of Jacob, whom he loved.
God has gone up amid praise, the Lord amid the sound of the horn.
Sing praise to God; sing to our King.
For God is King of all the earth; sing praise to him.
God reigns over the nations; God sits on his holy throne.
The rulers of the peoples have turned to the God of Abraham, for the dominions of the earth belong to God, and he is greatly exalted.
Our Lord is great and greatly praised in the city of our God and on his holy mountain.
Glorious, a joy throughout the earth, is Mount Zion, on the slopes of the north, the city of the great King.
God makes his strength known in her fortifications.
For look, the kings made ready and advanced together.
They saw, were amazed, and trembled.
Trembling seized them, and pains like those of a woman giving birth.
The ships of Tarshish will be shattered by a powerful wind.
Just as we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the mighty Lord, in the city of our God. God will establish her forever.
We have waited for your goodness, O God, within your temple.
Like your name, O God, your praises reach to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice, and let the daughters of Judah delight because of your judgments, Lord.
Walk around Zion, go all around her, and count her towers.
Pay attention to her defenses and examine her fortifications, so that you may tell the next generation.
For this is God, our God forever and ever, and he will guide me beyond death.
Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the earth.
Earth-born people and human beings alike, rich and poor.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will be understanding.
I will incline my ears to proverbs, and I will express my riddles with harps.
I am not afraid in evil days, when the wickedness of my enemies surrounds me.
All who trust in their strength and boast of their abundant wealth.
No brother can redeem, and no man can give God his ransom.
The ransom for their lives is costly; he toils forever.
So that you may live forever and ever and not see decay.
When you see wise people dying, fools and those without understanding perishing together and leaving their possessions to others.
Their graves are their houses forever, their dwellings for generation after generation, and they proclaim names on earth.
A person in his honored position did not understand, but was handed over to the animals and became like them.
This is their path, a stumbling block to themselves, and afterward they will take pleasure in their own words.

Like sheep they will be handed over to Sheol, and death will shepherd them. The upright will rule over them in the morning. Sheol will consume their form, and they will be driven away from their glories.
God will redeem my soul, and he will bring me up from the power of Sheol.
Do not be afraid when a man becomes rich and the honor of his household increases.
For he takes nothing at his death, nor will his glory go down after him.
For he blesses himself during his lifetime; he will thank you when you do him good.
And you will bring him to the generation of his ancestors; he will never see light.
A person who did not understand in his honored position was instead handed over to the wild animals and became like them.
God, the God of gods, the Lord, has spoken and called the earth, from the rising of the sun to its setting.
From Zion, perfect in glory, God has revealed himself.
God will come and will not be silent. Fire will devour before him, and around him it will blaze fiercely.
He will call to the heavens above and to the earth, to judge his people.
Gather to him, his chosen ones, who establish his covenant through sacrifice.
Let the heavens declare his righteousness, for God is the judge.
Listen, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices; your burnt offerings are always before me.
I will not take bulls from your house, nor goats from your flock.
For every wild animal is mine, as are the livestock on the mountains and the oxen.
I know every bird of the sky, and the wild animals are mine.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and everything in it are mine.
I do not eat the flesh of bulls, and I do not drink the blood of young goats.
Offer thanksgiving as a sacrifice to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Call on me in the day of distress; I will strengthen you, and you will glorify me.
God says to the sinner, “What have you to do with the writings of my commandments, that you take my covenant into your mouth?
Yet you hated my discipline and threw my words behind you.
When you saw a thief, you ran with him, and you cast your lot with adulterers.
Your mouth spoke evil things, and your tongue spoke deceit.
You sat and plotted against your brother, and you mocked your mother's son.
You did all these things, and I kept silent toward you. You thought, you wicked person, that I would be like you. But I will rebuke you and lay these things out before your eyes [?].
Understand this, you who forget God, lest he shatter you with no one to rescue you.
Whoever offers thanksgiving as a sacrifice glorifies me. There I will show him the way of the salvation of our God.”
Have mercy on me, O God, according to your grace, and according to your abundant compassion blot out my sins.
Wash me thoroughly from my wrongdoing, and cleanse me from my sins.
For I know my offenses, and my sins are always before me.
Against you alone have I sinned, and I have done evil before you, so that you may be shown righteous in your word and prevail in your judgments.
For I was conceived in wrongdoing, and in sins my mother conceived me.
But you desired truth, and you made known to me the hidden things of your wisdom.
Sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me with it, and I will be whiter than snow.
Satisfy me with your delight and your joy, and let my humbled bones rejoice.
Turn your face away from my sins, and blot out all my offenses.
Create a pure heart in me, O God, and renew your steadfast spirit within me.
Do not cast me away from your presence, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.
Instead, restore your joy and your salvation to me, and let your glorious spirit sustain me.
Then I will teach wrongdoers your way, and sinners will return to you.
Deliver me from bloodshed, my God, the God of my righteousness, and my tongue will praise your righteousness.
LORD, open my lips, and my mouth will proclaim your praises.
For you have not desired sacrifices, nor have you taken pleasure in whole burnt offerings.
The sacrifices of God are a humble spirit; God does not despise a crushed heart.
Do good to Zion according to your pleasure, and build the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will take pleasure in righteous sacrifices and whole burnt offerings; then they will offer bulls on your altar.
Why do you boast of evil, mighty man, and against the innocent all day long?
Your tongue plots wrongdoing, and like a sharpened razor you practice deceit.
You have loved evil things more than good things, and falsehood more than speaking what is right.
You have loved everyone who speaks wickedness, and deceitful tongues.
Therefore God will uproot him and sweep him away from his tent forever, and uproot him from the land of the living.
Then the righteous will see and rejoice and put their hope in the LORD.
They will say, “This is the man who did not make God his confidence, but trusted in his abundant wealth and grew arrogant over his possessions.”
But I am like a magnificent olive tree in the house of God. I have put my hope in God's grace forever and ever.
I will thank you forever for what you have done, and I will put my hope in your name throughout all generations, in the presence of your righteous ones.
The wicked man has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They have become corrupt and defiled by their wrongdoing, and there is no one who does good.
God looked down from heaven upon human beings to see whether anyone was wise and sought God.
They have all turned aside together and become defiled. There is no one who does good, not even one.
None of the evildoers understood—those who used to devour my people as though eating bread and did not call on God.
There they were terrified where there was nothing to fear, because God will scatter the bones of those who seek to please people. They were put to shame because God rejected them.
Who will bring salvation for Israel from Zion? When the LORD brings his people back from captivity, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
O God, save me by your name, and judge me by your might.
God, hear my prayer and listen to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen against me, and violent men have sought my life. They have given no thought to you, God.
God is my helper; the Lord sustains my life.
Bring disaster on my enemies, and in your faithfulness silence them.
I will willingly offer sacrifices to you and give thanks to your name, Lord, for it is good.
For you have rescued me from every distress, and my eyes have looked upon my enemies.
Listen to my prayer, God, and do not disregard my plea.
Hear me and answer me; turn toward my cry and hear me.
Because of my enemies and the oppression of the wicked, for they have brought injustices upon me and hated me.
And fear fell upon me.
And the shadows of death covered me.
I said, “Who would give me wings like a dove's? I would fly away and settle down.
I would fly far away and stay in the wilderness.
I would wait for someone to rescue me from the storm wind.”
Drown, my Lord, the perversity of their tongues, for I have seen strife and conflict in the city.
Day and night they go around its walls; injustice and deceit are within it.
And wickedness; deceit and treachery never leave its streets.
For it was not my enemy who insulted me—then I could have borne it. Nor was it someone who hated me who rose against me—then I could have hidden from him.
It was you, a man like me, my close companion and my friend.
We shared a meal together in God's house, as we walked in harmony.
Bring death upon them, and let them go down alive to Sheol, for evil is within them.
But I will call upon God, and God will save me.
In the evening, in the morning, and at noon I will reflect and speak, and make my voice heard.
Rescue my life from those who know me, for they have been in conflict with me.
God will hear and humble them, he who has existed since before the ages. There is no change in them, and they have not feared God.
They stretched out a hand against his neighbor and profaned his covenant.
They were troubled by the anger of his face and by the fury of his heart. His words are softer than oil, but they are [?].
Cast your care on the Lord, and he will sustain you. He will never let his righteous people be shaken.
But you, God, bring them down into the pit of destruction—those who shed blood and practice deceit. They will not complete their days, but I will put my hope in you.
Have mercy on me, God, because people trample me. All day long an attacker oppresses me.
My enemies trample me all day long, because a multitude of attackers has risen against me.
In the daytime I will not be afraid, because I trust in you.
In God I will boast. In God I have put my hope; I will not be afraid. What can a human being do to me?
All day long they were plotting against me and planning evil against me.
They hide and lie in wait, watching my footsteps as they wait for my life.
They said, “He has no one to rescue him.” In the anger of the nations, judge them, God.
I have made my confession known to you. Set my tears before you and in your book.
Then my enemies will turn back, and I will know that God is with me.
I will praise the word of God.
I trust in God; I will not be afraid. What can a human being do to me?
To you, God, I will fulfill my vows, and I will offer you a sacrifice of thanksgiving.
For you have rescued my life from death and my feet from stumbling, so that I may please you, God, in the land of the living.
Have mercy on me, God, because my soul hopes in you. I will take shelter in the shadow of your wings until the turmoil passes.
I will call to God Most High, to God my Savior,
who sent from heaven and saved me and put my enemies to shame. God sent his kindness and his truth,
and saved my life from dogs. I lay down while I was troubled. Human beings—their teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue is like a sharp sword.
Be exalted above the heavens, God, and let your glory be above the whole earth.
They prepared a trap for my feet and dug a pit for my life, but they fell into it.
My heart is ready, God; my heart is ready. I will praise and sing.
Wake up, my harp! Wake up, lyre and harp! I too will wake at dawn.
I will give thanks to you among the peoples, God, and sing to your name among the nations.
For your kindness has risen as high as heaven, and your faithfulness as high as the highest heavens.
Be exalted above the heavens, O God, and let your glory be over all the earth.
Do you truly speak what is right and judge fairly, you mortals?
Look, all of you speak injustice in the land, and your hands are entangled in injustice.
The wicked have been estranged from the womb; those who speak lies have gone astray from birth.
Their venom is like that of a deadly snake, like that of a deaf cobra that stops its ears,
so that it does not hear the voice of the charmer, the spellbinder, or the wise man.
May God break their teeth in their mouths. Tear out the lions’ fangs, LORD.
Let them drain away like water poured out, and let him shoot his arrows until they perish.
Like wax that melts and falls before a fire, let them be destroyed. Fire fell, but they did not see it; nor did they notice the sun.
Let their thorns become brambles, and let wrath shake them.
The righteous person will rejoice when he sees vengeance, and he will wash his hands in the blood of the wicked.
A person will say, “There is indeed fruit for the righteous; there is a God who will judge them on earth.”
Rescue me from my enemies, O God; lift me above those who rise against me.
Rescue me from evildoers, and save me from men who shed blood.
For they have ambushed me and intensified their wickedness against me—not because of my offenses or my sins, my Lord.
Without any fault on my part, they ran against me and prepared themselves against me. Wake up and see!
You, LORD, mighty God, God of Israel, awake and punish all the nations. Do not pardon any of the wicked.
They return in the evening, howl like dogs, and roam around the city.
The speech of their mouths is a sword on their lips, and they say, “Who hears?”
But you, LORD, laugh at them and mock all the nations.
O God, I will praise you, because you are my refuge.
O God, let your kindness go before me. O God, let me look upon my enemies.
Do not kill them, so that they do not lead my people astray. Instead, shake them by your power and drive them away, LORD, my confidence.
For the sin of their mouths, the speech of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, because they speak curses and lies.
Destroy them in your anger; destroy them until they can no longer be found, so that they may know that God rules over Jacob and to the ends of the earth.
They return in the evening, howl like dogs, and roam around the city.
Let them seek food but not be satisfied, and let them not settle down for the night.
But I will praise your strength, and in the morning I will praise your kindness, because you have been my refuge and my rescuer in the day of distress.
O God, I will sing to you, because you are the God of my refuge and the God who shows me kindness.
O God, you have forgotten me and pushed us away, and you have been angry with us.
You shook the earth and split it open. Bind up its fracture, for it is weakened.
You showed your people harsh things and made them drink wine that makes them stagger.
You gave those who fear you a sign, so that they would not flee before your bow.
So that your beloved ones may be delivered, save me with your right hand and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness: “I will be strong. I will divide Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.”
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is the protection of my head; Judah is my king.
Moab is the washbasin for my feet. Over Edom I will remove my sandals, and over Philistia I will shout.
Who will lead me as far as Edom? Who will bring me to the fortified city?
For you, God, have forgotten me, and you do not go out with our armies.
Give us help against our enemies, for human deliverance is deceptive.
Hear my prayer, God, and listen to my plea.
From the ends of the earth I call to you in the distress of my heart, for you lifted me onto a rock and comforted me.
For you have been a refuge for me, a high tower against my enemies.
May I dwell in your tent forever and take shelter in the shade of your wings.
For you, God, have heard my vows and given an inheritance to those who fear your name.
You have added days to the king’s days, and his years extend through generations.
May he remain forever before God. Kindness and truth—who will preserve them?
So I will sing praises to your name forever and ever, fulfilling my vows day after day.
My soul waits for God, for my salvation comes from him.
