Let them be cursed, but may you be blessed, and let your servant rejoice.
Let those who were hostile to me be clothed with shame, and let them wrap themselves in it like a cloak.
I will give thanks to the LORD with my mouth, and I will praise him among many people.
For he stood at the right hand of the wicked man to save his life from judgment.
The LORD said to my lord, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”
The LORD will send a mighty scepter from Zion, and he will rule over your enemies.
Your people are glorious on the day of power, in holy splendor. From the womb, from the beginning, I have begotten you, O child.
The LORD has sworn and will not go back on his word: “You are a priest forever, in the likeness of Melchizedek.”
The LORD at your right hand shattered kings on the day of his anger.
He will judge the nations, heap up corpses, and cut off the heads of many in the land.
He will drink from the stream along the way; therefore his head will be lifted up.
I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, in the assembly.
Great are the works of the Lord, and they are sought out by all who delight in them.
His works are glorious and great, and his righteousness endures forever.
He has made his wonders remembered. The LORD is merciful and compassionate.
He has given food to those who fear him, and he remembers his covenant forever.
He showed his people the power in his works, to give them the inheritance of the nations.
And all his commandments are firmly established.
And they are carried out in righteousness and truth.
He sent redemption to his people, and he remembers his covenant forever. His name is holy and awe-inspiring.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and those who practice it have good understanding. His praise endures forever.
Blessed is the man who fears the LORD and carefully keeps his commandments.
His offspring will be mighty in the land and will be blessed among the generation of the righteous.
Possessions and wealth will increase in his house, and his righteousness will endure forever.
Light has dawned in the darkness for the upright, and he has mercy on the righteous.
Good is the man who shows mercy and lends, and conducts his affairs with justice.
He will never be shaken; the righteous will be remembered forever.
He will not fear bad news, for his heart is steadfast, trusting in God.
His heart is firm, and he is not afraid, until he looks upon his enemies.
He has distributed freely and given to the poor; his righteousness endures forever and ever, and his horn will be raised in glory.
The unjust man will see and become angry; he will gnash his teeth and be troubled, and the desire of the wicked will perish.
Praise, you servants of the Lord; praise the name of the Lord.
May the name of the Lord be blessed from everlasting to everlasting.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, great is the name of the Lord.
The Lord is exalted above all nations, and his glory is above the heavens.
Who is like the Lord our God, who sits on high
and looks down into the depths, in heaven and on earth?
He raises the poor from the dunghill,
to seat him with the nobles of the people.
He settles the barren woman in a home as a joyful mother of children.
When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign speech,
Judah became his sanctuary, and Israel his praise.
The sea saw him and fled, and the Jordan turned back.
The mountains skipped like rams, and the hills like lambs of the flock.
What happened to you, sea, that you fled, and to you, Jordan, that you turned back?
You mountains, why did you skip like rams, and you hills like lambs of the flock?
The earth trembled before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turned the rock into pools of water, and the hard stone into springs of water.
Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, because of your goodness and your faithfulness.
Do not let the nations say, “Where is their God?”
Our God is in heaven, and he does whatever he pleases.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths but do not speak; they have eyes but do not see.
They have ears but do not hear; they have noses but do not smell.
They cannot feel with their hands or walk with their feet, and they cannot speak with their throats.
May those who make them become like them, along with all who trust in them.
The house of Israel trusts in the Lord; he is their helper and supporter.
The house of Aaron trusts in the Lord; he is their helper and supporter.
Those who fear the Lord trust in the Lord; he is their helper and supporter.
The Lord has remembered us and blessed us. He will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
The Lord will bless those who fear him, small and great alike.
May the Lord increase your numbers, yours and your children's.
You are blessed by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
The highest heavens belong to the Lord, but the earth he has given to human beings.
The dead will not praise the Lord, nor will any who go down into darkness.
But we will bless the Lord from now on and forever.
I love that the Lord hears the voice of my pleading
and turns his ear toward me on the day I call upon him.
For the cords of death surrounded me, and the agonies of Sheol overtook me; I encountered distress and [?].
Then I called on the name of the Lord: “Please, Lord, rescue my soul!”
You are compassionate, Lord, and righteous; you are a merciful God.
The Lord protects the simple; he humbled me and saved me.
Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has rewarded you.
For you have rescued my soul from death and my feet from stumbling.
So that I may please you, Lord, in the land of the living.
I believed and spoke, and I was greatly humbled.
I said in my alarm, “Every human being is a liar.”
What shall I repay the Lord for all his benefits to me?
I will receive the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord.
I will fulfill my vows to the Lord before all the people.
Precious in the eyes of the Lord is the death of his righteous ones.
O Lord, I am your servant; I am your servant and the son of your maidservant. You have freed me from my bonds.
To you I will offer sacrifices of praise, and I will call on the name of the Lord.
I will fulfill my vows to the Lord before all his people.
In the courts of the Lord’s house, and in your midst, Jerusalem.
Praise the Lord, all you nations; praise him, all you peoples.
For his grace toward us has been mighty. Truly, the Lord is forever.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, and his mercy lasts forever.
Let Israel say, “His mercy lasts forever.”
Let the house of Aaron say, “His mercy lasts forever.”
Let those who fear the Lord say, “His mercy lasts forever.”
In distress I called to the Lord, and the Lord answered me with relief.
The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can a human being do to me?
The Lord is my helper, and I will look upon those who hate me.
It is better to trust in the Lord than to trust in a human being.
It is good to trust in the Lord, better than trusting in a ruler.
All the nations surrounded me, and in the name of the Lord I destroyed them.
They encircled me and surrounded me, and in the name of the Lord I destroyed them.
They surrounded me like bees, but they were extinguished like a fire of stubble, and in the name of the Lord I destroyed them.
I was pushed so that I would be thrown down and fall, but the Lord helped me.
The Lord is my strength and my praise, and he has become my savior.
The sound of praise and salvation is in the tent of the righteous. The Lord’s right hand has acted mightily.
The Lord’s right hand has lifted me up; the Lord’s right hand has done mighty deeds.
I will not die but live, and I will recount the Lord’s deeds.
The Lord has disciplined me severely, but he has not handed me over to death.
Open the gates of righteousness for me, so that I may enter them and give thanks to the Lord.
This is the Lord’s gate; the righteous enter through it.
I will give thanks to you because you answered me and became my savior.
The stone the builders rejected has become the chief stone of the building.
This has come from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
This is the day the Lord has made. Come, let us rejoice and be glad in it.
O Lord, save me! O Lord, deliver me!
Blessed is the one who comes in the Lord’s name. We bless you from the Lord’s house.
The Lord our God has given us light. Bind our festivals with chains, all the way to the horns of the altar.
You are my God; I will give thanks to you. You are my God; I will praise you.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, and his kindness lasts forever.
Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the Lord.
Blessed are those who keep his testimony and seek him with all their heart.
They have done no wrong and have walked in his ways.
You commanded that your commandments be kept diligently.
Oh, that my ways were firmly established so that I might keep your commandments!
I will not be ashamed when I keep all your commandments.
I will give thanks to you with an upright heart when I have learned your righteous judgments.
I have kept your commandments; do not abandon me forever.
How can a young man make his way pure? By keeping your commandments.
With all my heart I have sought you; do not let me stray from your commandments.
I have hidden your words in my heart so that I may not sin against you.
Blessed are you, Lord; teach me your commandments.
With my lips I have recounted all your righteous judgments.
I have loved the way of your testimony more than all wealth.
I meditated on your commandments and came to know your ways.
I meditated on your law so that I would not forget your words.
Answer your servant, so that I may live and keep your words.
Open my eyes so that I may see the wonders in your law.
I am a guest with you; do not hide your commandments from me.
My soul desired and longed for your judgments at all times.
You rebuked the nations, and those who stray from your commandments are cursed.
Remove disgrace from me, because I have kept your testimony.
The wicked sat and talked about me, but I meditated on your commandments.
I meditated on your testimony and on your good counsel.
My soul clings to the dust; give me life according to your word.
I showed you my ways, and you answered me; teach me your law.
Show me the way of your commandments, and I will meditate on your wonders.
My soul is troubled by worry; give me life according to your word.
Remove the way of wrongdoing from me, and teach me your law.
I chose the way of your faithfulness and delighted in your judgments.
I clung to your testimony; Lord, do not put me to shame.
I walked in the way of your commandments because you made me glad.
Teach me, Lord, the way of your commandments, and I will keep them.
Give me understanding so that I may keep your law; I will keep it with all my heart.
Lead me along the path of your commandments, for I delight in it.
Turn my heart toward your testimony and not toward proverbs.
Turn my eyes away from looking at falsehood, and give me life in your ways.
Confirm your word to your servant who fears you.
Remove disgrace from me, because your judgments are good.
I delighted in your commandments; give me life through your righteousness.
Let your mercy come upon me, Lord, and your salvation, as you have promised.
I will give an answer to those who insult me, because I have trusted in your words.
Do not remove the word of truth from my mouth, for I have waited for your judgments.
I will keep your law forever and ever.
I will walk freely, because I have delighted in your commandments.
I will speak righteously before kings and will not be ashamed.
I will meditate on your commandments, which I love.
I will lift my hands toward your commandments, which I love; I will meditate on them, on your commandments, and boast in your faithfulness.
Remember your word to your servant, on which you have made me rely.
Through it I was comforted in my humiliation, because your word gave me life.
The wicked oppressed me, but I did not turn aside from your law.
I remembered your judgments from long ago, Lord, and was comforted, and they became instruction for me.
Sorrow seized me because of the sinners who abandoned your law.
Your commandments became a song for me in the place where I lived as a stranger.
I remembered your name in the night, Lord, and kept your law.
I was comforted because I kept your commandments.
I reflected on the Lord’s portion, that I should keep your commandments.
I sought your face with all my heart; have mercy on me according to your word.
I considered my ways and turned my feet toward your paths.
I prepared myself and did not delay in keeping your commandments.
The cords of the wicked entangled me, but I did not turn aside from your law.
At midnight I rose to thank you for your righteous judgments.
I am a friend of all who fear you and of those who keep your commandments.
The earth is full of your mercy, Lord; teach me your commandments.
Do good to your servant, Lord, as you have said.
Teach me discernment, goodness, and knowledge, because I have believed in your commandments.
Before I was humbled, I believed, and I kept your word.
You are good, Lord, and you do good; teach me your commandments.
Great is the wrongdoing of the proud, but I have kept your commandments with all my heart.
Their hearts have curdled like milk, but I have kept your law.
It was good for me to be humbled, so that I might learn your commandments.
The law from your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
Your hands made me and formed me; teach me your law.
May those who fear you see and rejoice, because I have put my hope in your word.
I know that your judgments are righteous, Lord, and your faithfulness has humbled me.
Let your mercies comfort me, as you have said to your servant.
Let your mercies come upon me so that I may live, because I have been instructed in your law.
Let the wicked be ashamed, because they have unjustly humbled me; but I have meditated on your commandments.
Let those who fear you turn to me, along with those who know your testimony.
Let my heart meditate on your commandments, so that I will not be ashamed.
My soul longs for your salvation, and I have put my hope in your word.
My eyes wait for your promise, asking, “When will you comfort me?”
Though I have become like a wineskin in the frost, I have not forgotten your commandments.
How many are the days of your servant? When will you give me justice against my persecutors?
The wicked, who do not follow your law, have dug a pit for me.
All your commandments are trustworthy, but the wicked have persecuted me.
They almost destroyed me on earth, but I did not abandon your commandments.
Give me life according to your mercy, so that I may keep the testimony of your mouth.
You are forever, Lord, and your word stands firm in heaven.
Your faithfulness continues from generation to generation. You established the earth and made it stand firm.
If your law had not been my meditation, I would have perished in my affliction.
I will never forget your commandments, because my life is in them.
I am yours; rescue me, because I have kept your commandments.
The wicked have lain in wait for me to destroy me, but I have considered your testimony.
I have seen an end to everything, but your commandment is exceedingly broad.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day long.
Make me wiser than my enemies, because I have kept your commandments.
Give me more understanding than all my teachers, because your testimony has been my meditation.
I have gained more understanding than the elders, because I have kept your commandments.
I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I may keep your commandments.
I have not turned aside from your judgments, because you have taught me.
Your words are sweet to my palate, much sweeter than honey to the mouth.
I have meditated on your commandments; therefore I hate every path of the wicked.
Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my paths.
I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep your righteous judgments.
I have been greatly humbled. Lord, give me life according to your word.
Take pleasure in the words of my mouth, Lord, and teach me your judgments.
My life is always in your hands, and I have not forgotten your law.
Sinners have set traps for me, but I have not strayed from your commandments.
I have inherited your testimony forever, for it is the delight of my heart.
I have turned my heart to carry out your commandments faithfully forever.
I hate the wicked, but I love your law.
You are my shelter and my refuge, and I have placed my hope in your word.
Depart from me, you wicked people, so that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Uphold me by your word so that I may live, and do not let me be put to shame in my hope.
Help me so that I may be saved, and I will continually learn your commandments.
You have rejected all who stray from you, for their thoughts are wicked.
Support me so that I may be saved, and I will meditate on your commandments at all times.
My flesh shudders in fear of you, and I am afraid of your judgments.
Carry out justice and righteousness; do not leave me in the hands of my oppressors.
Give your servant delight in good things, and do not let the arrogant oppress me.
My eyes wait for your salvation and for your righteous promise.
Deal with your servant according to your mercy, and teach me your law.
I am your servant; give me understanding so that I may know your testimony.
It is time to serve the Lord, and look, they have made your law void.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold and more than precious stones.
I love all your commandments, and I hate every path of the wicked.
Your testimonies are great; therefore my soul has kept them.
Unfold your word, give light, and give understanding to children.
I opened my mouth and drew breath, and I waited for your salvation.
Turn to me and have mercy on me, because I love your name.
Make my steps firm in your paths, and do not let wickedness rule over me.
Rescue me from human oppression, so that I may keep your commandments.
Let your face shine on your servant, and teach me your law.
Streams of water flowed from my eyes because they did not keep your law.
You are righteous, Lord, and your judgments are entirely just.
You gave your decrees in righteousness and faithfulness.
Zeal torments me constantly, because your enemies have forgotten your word.
Your word is most excellent, and your servant loves it.
I am insignificant and despised, but I have not forgotten your commandments.
Your righteousness stands forever, and your law is true.
Distress and anguish have come upon me, but I have meditated on your commandments.
Your decrees are righteous forever. Give me understanding, so that I may live.
I called to you with all my heart, Lord; answer me, and I will keep your commandments.
I called to you: save me, and I will keep your decrees.
I rose early in the morning and cried out, and I waited for your word.
My eyes were awake before the night watch, so that I might meditate on your word.
Hear my voice, Lord, according to your mercy, and give me life according to your judgments.
Those who persecute me unjustly have drawn near, but they have gone far from your law.
You are near, Lord, and all your commandments are true.
Long ago I knew your decrees, because you established them from eternity.
See my humiliation and rescue me, because I have not forgotten your law.
Defend my cause and rescue me; give me life according to your word.
Salvation is far from the wicked, because they have not sought your commandments.
Your mercies are many, Lord; give me life according to your judgments.
My persecutors and enemies are many, but I have not turned aside from your decrees.
I saw the wicked and knew that they had not kept your word.
See how I have loved your commandments, Lord; in your grace, give me life.
The foundation of your word is truth, and all your righteous judgments last forever.
Rulers persecuted me without cause, but my heart trembled at your word.
I rejoiced in your word like someone who finds abundant plunder.
I hated and rejected wrongdoing, but I loved your law.
Seven times a day I praised you for your righteous judgments.
Great is the peace of those who love your law, and they have no distress.
I hoped for your salvation, Lord, and carried out your commandments.
My soul kept your testimony, and I loved it greatly.
I kept your commandments and your testimonies, and all my ways are before you.
Let my praise come before you, Lord, and give me life through your word.
Let my plea come before you, and rescue me through your word.
My lips will speak your praises when you teach me your commandments.
Let my tongue pour forth your word, because all your commandments are righteous.
Let your hand help me, because I have delighted in your commandments.
My soul waited for your salvation, and I meditated on your law.
Let my soul live and praise you, and let your judgment help me.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, because I have not forgotten your commandments.
I called to the Lord in my distress, and he answered me.
Lord, rescue my soul from wicked lips and deceitful tongues.
What will they give you, and what will they add to you, deceitful tongues?
A warrior’s arrows are sharp, like burning oak coals.
Woe to me, for my stay as a foreigner has grown long, and I have settled in the tent of Kedar.
My soul has lived too long with those who hate peace.
I spoke of peace, but they fought against me.
I will lift my eyes to the mountain. Where will my helper come from?
My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
He will not let your foot slip, and your guardian will not slumber.
For the guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
The Lord is your guardian; the Lord shades you with his right hand.
The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
The Lord will guard you from every evil; he guards your life.
The Lord guards your going out and your coming in, from now and forever.
I rejoiced when they said to me, “We are going to the Lord’s house.”
My feet were standing within your gates, Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is built like a city surrounded by a wall.
There the tribes went up, the tribes of the Lord, as a testimony to Israel, to give thanks to the Lord’s name.
For there they set up thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. May those who love you prosper.
May there be peace within your fortifications and prosperity within your palaces.
For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will speak peace over you.
For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your good.
I have lifted my eyes to you, you who dwell in heaven.
As servants’ eyes look toward their masters, and as a maidservant’s eyes look toward her mistress, so our eyes look toward you, Lord our God, until you have mercy on us.
Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, for we have heard so much contempt.
Our souls have had more than enough of the insults of mockers and the contempt of the arrogant.
If the Lord had not stood by us—let Israel say—
For if the Lord had not stood by us when people rose against us—
They would have swallowed us alive when their anger flared against us.
They would have drowned us in the waters; a torrent swept over us.
And mighty waters would have swept over our lives.
Blessed is the Lord, who did not give us as food for their teeth.
Our soul escaped like a bird from the hunter’s trap. The trap was broken, and we escaped.
And our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
Those who trust in the Lord on Mount Zion will not be shaken, but will remain forever.
Mountains surround Jerusalem, and the Lord surrounds his people, from now and forever.
For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the portion of the righteous, so that the righteous will not stretch out their hands to wrongdoing.
Do good, Lord, to the good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
But those who make their paths crooked, the Lord will lead away with evildoers. Peace be upon Israel!
When the Lord brought back the captives of Zion, we were like those who rejoice.
Then our mouths will be filled with laughter and our tongues with praise. Then they will say among the nations, “The Lord has done great things for these people.”
The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.
Bring back our captives, Lord, like streams in the south.
Those who sow in tears will reap with joy.
The one who carries seed goes on his way weeping; the one who carries a sheaf will surely come with joy.
Unless the Lord builds the house, its builders labor in vain. Unless the Lord guards the city, its guards keep watch in vain.
Those who rise early and sit down late, eating bread in sorrow, do so in vain. Thus he gives sleep to those he loves.
For children are an inheritance from the Lord, a reward—the fruit in the womb.
Like an arrow in the hand of a warrior, so are the children of one's youth.
Happy is the man who fills his quiver with them. They will not be ashamed when they speak with the enemy at the gate.
Happy is everyone who fears the Lord and walks in his paths.
When you eat what your hands have worked for, O man, happy are you, and it will be well with you.
Your wife is like a flourishing vine in the inner parts of your house; your children are like olive saplings surrounding your table.
This is how the man who fears the Lord will be blessed.
May the Lord bless you from Zion, and may you see Jerusalem's prosperity all the days of your life.
May you see your children's children. Peace be upon Israel!
“My oppressors have been many since my youth,” let Israel say.
“My oppressors have been many since my youth, but they have not overpowered me.”
Scourgers lashed my back and prolonged their humiliation of me.
The Lord is righteous and cuts off the branches of the wicked.
May all who hate Zion turn back.
Let them be like grass on a roof, which withers and dries up when the wind blows on it.
The reaper does not fill his hand with it, nor does the sheaf-binder fill his lap.
Those who pass by do not say, “The blessing of the Lord be upon you! We bless you in the name of the Lord.”
From the depths I called to you, Lord.
And you heard my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the sound of my pleading.
If you keep account of sins, Lord, who can stand?
For forgiveness comes from you.
I hoped in the Lord, and my soul waited; I waited for his word.
For the Lord, from the morning watch until the morning watch.
Let Israel wait for the Lord, because mercy comes from him, and with him there is abundant redemption.
He will redeem Israel from all its wrongdoing.
Lord, my heart was not proud, nor were my eyes haughty, and I did not concern myself with things too great for me.
Instead, I humbled my soul like a weaned child with its mother, and my soul within me became like a weaned child.
Let Israel wait for the Lord, from now and forever.
Remember David, Lord, and all his humility.
He swore to the Lord and made a vow to the God of Jacob.
I will not enter the shelter of my house or climb onto the bedding of my bed.
“I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids
until I find a place for the Lord, a dwelling for the God of Jacob.”
Look, we heard of it in Ephrathah, and we found it in the fields.
Let us enter his dwelling and bow down at his footstool.
Rise, Lord, to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.
Let your priests clothe themselves in righteousness, and your righteous ones in glory.
For the sake of David your servant, do not turn away the face of your anointed one.
The Lord swore to David in truth and will not turn back from it: “I will set one of your offspring on your throne.
If your sons keep my covenant, this testimony that I teach them, then some of their sons too will sit on your throne forever and ever.”
For the Lord desired Zion and chose it as his dwelling place.
This is my resting place forever and ever. Here I will dwell, because I have desired it.
I will bless her hunters, and I will satisfy her poor with bread.
I will clothe her priests with salvation and her righteous people with glory.
There I will make a horn rise for David and make a lamp shine for his anointed one.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, and my holiness will flourish upon him.
How good and how pleasant it is when brothers live together in unity!
It is like oil flowing down over the head and over the beard, Aaron’s beard, flowing down onto the collar of his robe.
It is like the dew of Hermon descending on Mount Zion, for there the Lord commanded the blessing and life forever.
Bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord who stand in the house of the Lord at night.
Lift your hands toward the sanctuary and bless the Lord.
May the Lord, who made heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
Praise the name of the Lord; praise him, you servants of the Lord,
you who stand in the house of the Lord and in the courts of the house of our God.
Praise the Lord, for he is good; sing praises to his name, for he is pleasant.
For the Lord chose Jacob for himself, and Israel as his congregation.
For I know that the Lord is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
Whatever the Lord wishes, he does, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and in all the depths.
He raises clouds from the ends of the earth; he makes lightning for the rain; he brings winds out of storehouses.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both humans and livestock.
He sent his signs and wonders into Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings:
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance to Israel his people.
Lord, your name endures forever; Lord, your remembrance endures through all generations.
For the Lord judges his people and takes comfort in his servants.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
They have mouths but do not speak; they have eyes but do not see.
They have ears but do not hear, and there is no breath in their mouths.
May those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them.
House of Israel, bless the Lord! House of Aaron, bless the Lord!
House of Levi, bless the Lord! You who fear the Lord, bless the Lord!
Blessed be the Lord from Zion, he who dwells in Jerusalem.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, and his mercy endures forever.
Give thanks to the God of gods, for his mercy endures forever.
Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who alone does great wonders, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who made the heavens in his wisdom, for his mercy lasts forever.
To him who spread out the earth over the waters, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who made the great lights, for his mercy endures forever.
The sun to rule the day, for his mercy endures forever.
The moon and stars to rule the night, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, for his mercy endures forever.
And brought Israel out from among them, for his mercy endures forever.
With a mighty hand and an uplifted arm, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who divided the Red Sea, for his mercy endures forever.
And brought Israel through it, for his mercy endures forever.
And swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who led his people through the wilderness, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who struck down great kings, for his mercy endures forever.
And killed mighty kings, for his mercy endures forever.
Sihon, king of the Amorites, for his mercy endures forever.
And Og, king of Bashan, for his mercy endures forever.
And gave their land as an inheritance, for his mercy endures forever.
An inheritance to Israel his servant, for his mercy endures forever.
To him who remembered us in our humiliation, for his mercy lasts forever.
And rescued us from our enemies, for his mercy lasts forever.
To him who gives food to all living creatures, for his mercy lasts forever.
Give thanks to the God of heaven, for his mercy lasts forever.
By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
On the willows within it we hung our harps.
For there our captors asked us for songs of praise, and those who led us away said to us, “Sing us some of Zion’s songs of praise.”
How can we sing the Lord’s songs of praise for you in a foreign land?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget me.
May my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not place Jerusalem above my greatest joys.
Remember, Lord, the Edomites on Jerusalem’s day, who said, “Strip it bare! Strip it bare, down to its foundations!”
Daughter Babylon, you plunderer, blessed is the one who repays you with the repayment you gave him.
Blessed is the one who seizes your little children and smashes them against the rock.
I will thank you, Lord, with all my heart, and before kings I will sing to you.
I will bow down in your holy temple and give thanks to your name for your kindness and your faithfulness, for you have exalted your word above every name.
On the day I called to you, you answered me and increased the strength of my soul.
All the kings of the earth will thank you, Lord, because they have heard the words of your mouth.
They will praise the Lord’s ways, for great is the Lord’s glory.
The Lord is exalted, yet he sees into the depths, and he knows from afar the one who exalts himself.
If I walk amid distress, you will keep me alive. Against the anger of my enemies you will stretch out your hand, and your right hand will save me.
Lord, shelter me. Lord, your mercy lasts forever. Do not abandon the work of your hands.
Lord, you have searched me and known me.
You know when I sit down and when I rise. You understand my thoughts from on high.
You know my way and my paths, and you have examined all my ways.
If there is any change in my speech, you, Lord, know it all.
You formed me before and behind, and laid your hand upon me.
Knowledge is beyond me, and wonder is too powerful; I cannot attain it.
Where can I go from your Spirit, and where can I hide from your presence?
If I ascend to heaven, you are there; if I descend to Sheol, you are there too.
If I raise my wings like an eagle’s and settle at the farthest end of the sea,
even there your hand will hold me, and your right hand will lead me.
I said, “Let the darkness shine for me, and let the night shine before me.”
Darkness is not dark to you; the night shines like the day, and darkness is like light.
For you formed my kidneys and received me from my mother’s womb.
I will thank you for the wonderful thing you have done, for your works are exalted, and my soul knows it very well.
My bones, which you made in secret, were not hidden from you. I descended to the depths of the earth.
My eyes have seen my recompense. In your books they will all be written [?]. Look, the days have been shortened, and there is no one among them.
Your friends are greatly honored by me, God, and their powers are very strong.
If I count them, they outnumber the sand. I awake, and I am still with you.
If only you would kill the sinners, O God, and bloodthirsty men would depart from me!
For they spoke of you and took your city in vain [?].
I hate those who hate you, Lord, and I am angry with those who rise against you.
I hate them with complete hatred; they have become my enemies.
Search me, O God, and know my heart; examine me and know my ways.
See whether there is any way of falsehood in me, and lead me in your everlasting way.
Rescue me, Lord, from an evil person, and protect me from wicked men,
who plan evil in their hearts and stir up conflict all day long.
They sharpen their tongues like a snake’s, and the venom of an asp is under their tongues.
Protect me, Lord, from the hands of the wicked, and protect me from violent men who have planned to make my steps slip.
The arrogant have hidden snares for me; they have spread the cords of their nets across my paths and cast a net over me.
I said to the Lord, “You are my God; listen to the sound of my plea.”
The Lord, my mighty Savior, is the shelter of my head on the day of battle.
Lord, do not grant the wicked man his desire, and do not let his plan succeed.
As for my head, may the wickedness of their lips cover them.
May burning coals descend on them, and may they fall into the fire and be unable to rise.
May a slanderer not be established in the land; may evil hunt down the wicked man to his destruction.
I know that the Lord secures justice for the poor and justice for the afflicted.
Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name, and the upright will dwell in your presence.
Lord, I have called to you; answer me. Listen to my words and accept them.
My prayer is like incense before you, the offering of my hands like the evening offering.
Lord, set a guard over my mouth and a guard over my lips.
Do not let my heart turn toward an evil matter, so that I do wicked deeds with wicked men. Let me not share meals with them.
Let a righteous person teach me and rebuke me. Let the oil of the wicked not anoint my head, for my prayer is against their wickedness.
Their judges were restrained by the power of the rock, and he heard my words, which are pleasant.
Like a plowshare that splits the earth, their bones were scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
But I have lifted my eyes to you, Lord, and have trusted in you. Do not cast away my life.
Protect me from the power of the arrogant, who have hidden snares for me.
Let the wicked fall together into their own traps until I pass by.
With my voice I called to the Lord; with my voice I pleaded with the Lord.
I laid my plea before him and made my distress known before him.
When my spirit was troubled, you knew my paths. On the road where I walked, they hid snares for me.
I looked to the right and saw that no one acknowledged me. I had no refuge left, and no one cared for my life.
I cried out to you, Lord, and said, “You are my hope and my portion in the land of the living.”
Listen to my plea, for I have been brought very low. Rescue me from my persecutors, for they are stronger than I am.
Bring my soul out of prison so that I may give thanks to your name. Your righteous people will wait for me when you repay me.
Hear my prayer, Lord, and listen to my plea; answer me according to your word and your righteousness.
Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is innocent before you.
For the enemy has pursued my soul and brought my life low to the ground. He has made me dwell in darkness like those who are dead forever.
My spirit was troubled within me, and my heart trembled inside me.
I remembered you, Lord, from long ago. I meditated on all your deeds and reflected on the work of your hands.
I stretched out my hands toward you. My soul thirsts for you like the land.
Answer me quickly, Lord, for my spirit is failing. Do not turn your face away from me, so that I am not given over with those who go down to the pit.
Let me hear of your kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Show me your way, so that I may walk in it, for to you, Lord, I have lifted up my soul.
Rescue me from my enemies.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. May your gracious Spirit lead me on the path of life.
For your name's sake, Lord, comfort me, and in your righteousness bring my soul out of distress.
In your grace, silence those who hate me and destroy the enemies of my life, because I am your servant.
Blessed is the Lord, who trained my hands for battle and my fingers for war.
He is my refuge and my deliverer, my helper in whom I trust, who has subjected peoples beneath me.
Lord, what is a human being that you know him, a mortal that you take account of him?
A human being is like a breath, and his days pass like a shadow.
Bend down the heavens, Lord, and come down. Rebuke the mountains, and they will smoke.
Flash your lightning and throw them into confusion. Send out your arrows and scatter them.
Stretch out your hand from on high and draw me out of the mighty waters and from the hand of the wicked.
Their mouths speak falsehood, and their right hands are right hands of wickedness.
God, I will sing a new song of praise to you; on a ten-stringed harp I will make music to you.
You give victory to the king and rescue David your servant from the deadly sword.
Rescue me from the hand of the wicked, whose mouths speak falsehood and whose right hands are right hands of wickedness.
Our sons are like plants growing from their youth, and our daughters are like brides adorned in the likeness of palaces.
Our storehouses are full, overflowing from one to another. Our sheep give birth and multiply in our streets.
Our cattle are strong, and none of them is barren. There is no breach and no wailing in our streets.
Blessed are the people for whom this is so. Blessed are the people whose God is the Lord.
I will exalt you, my Lord the King, and bless your name forever and ever.
Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever.
Our Lord is great and greatly praised, and his greatness has no limit.
Generation after generation will recount your works and proclaim your might.
They will speak of the power of your awe-inspiring deeds and recount your great deeds.
They will speak of your awe-inspiring power, and I will recount your greatness.
Your righteous people will seek the remembrance of your many acts of kindness and find it.
The Lord is merciful and compassionate, slow to anger and abundant in kindness.
The Lord is good, and his mercy extends over all his works.
Your works will give thanks to you, Lord, and your righteous people will praise you.
They will speak of the glory of your kingdom and tell of your power,
to make your might and the glory of your kingdom known to humankind.
Your kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, and your dominion endures through every generation. The Lord is faithful in his words and righteous in all his works.
The Lord supports all who fall and straightens all who are bent down.
Everyone's eyes look expectantly to you, and you give them food at the proper time.
You open your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
The Lord is righteous in all his ways and merciful in all his works.
The Lord is near to those who call on him in truth.
He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; he hears their plea and saves them.
The Lord guards all who fear him, but he destroys all the wicked.
I will speak the praises of the Lord with my mouth, and let all humanity bless his holy name forever and ever.
Praise the Lord, my soul.
I will praise the Lord throughout my life and sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
Do not put your trust in a ruler or in a human being who has no power to save.
His breath departs, and he returns to his earth; on that day all his plans perish.
Blessed is the one whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope rests on the Lord his God,
who made heaven and earth, the seas and everything in them, who remains faithful forever.
And he gives justice to the oppressed and bread to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free.
The Lord opens the eyes of the blind. The Lord straightens those who are bent over. The Lord loves the righteous.
The Lord protects the poor, sustains orphans and widows, and brings the way of the wicked to ruin.
The Lord will reign forever, your God, Zion, through all generations.
It is good and pleasant to sing to our God, and praise is fitting for him.
The Lord builds Jerusalem and gathers the scattered people of Israel.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
He counts the stars and calls them all by name.
Our Lord is great, and his power is mighty. His understanding has no limit.
The Lord lifts up the poor and brings the wicked down to the ground.
Praise the Lord with praise; sing to the Lord with harps.
He covers the sky with clouds, gives rain upon the earth, and makes grass grow on the mountains.
He gives food to the animals and to the young ravens that cry out.
The Lord takes no pleasure in the strength of a horse, nor does he take pleasure in the legs of a warrior.
But the Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him and those who wait for his kindness.
Praise the Lord, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
For the bars of your gates have grown strong, and he has blessed your children within you.
He makes your borders peaceful and satisfies you with the finest wheat.
He sends his word upon the earth; his command runs swiftly.
He gives snow like wool and scatters frost like ashes.
He casts down ice like pieces. Who can stand before his cold?
He sends his word and melts them; he makes winds blow, and the waters flow.
He makes his word known to Jacob, his laws and his commandments to Israel.
He has not done this for all the nations, nor has he made his judgments known to them.
Praise the Lord from the heavens; praise him in the heights.
Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his armies.
Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all stars and light.
Praise him, highest heavens, and waters above the heavens.
Let them praise the name of the Lord, for he spoke and they came into being; he commanded and they were created.
He established them forever and ever; he gave a law that does not pass away.
Praise the Lord from the earth, sea monsters and all the depths.
Fire and hail, snow and ice, winds and storms that carry out his word.
Mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars.
Wild animals and all livestock, crawling creatures, birds, and flying creatures.
Kings of the earth and all nations, rulers and all judges of the earth.
Young men and young women, old people and youths.
Let them praise the name of the Lord, for his name alone is great; his glory is on earth and in heaven.
He raises the horn of his people, bringing praise to all his righteous ones and to the children of Israel, the people close to him.
Praise the Lord with a new song; praise him in the assembly of the righteous.
Let Israel rejoice in its Maker, and let the children of Zion delight in their King.
Let them praise his name with tambourines and drums; let them sing to him with harps.
For the Lord takes pleasure in his people and gives his salvation to the poor.
Let the righteous grow strong in honor, and let them praise him on their beds.
Let them exalt God with their throats, with a double-edged sword in their hands,
to exact vengeance on the peoples and punishment on the nations,
to bind their kings with fetters and their nobles with iron chains,
to carry out on them the judgment that is written. This is glory for all his righteous ones.
Praise the Lord in his sanctuary; praise him in the mighty expanse of his heavens.
Praise him for his mighty power; praise him for his abundant greatness.
Praise him with the sound of the horn; praise him with lyres and harps.
Praise him with drums and [?]; praise him with sweet-sounding instruments.
Praise him with resounding cymbals; praise him with sound and shouting.
Let everything that breathes praise the Lord.
